about_short_description.short_description: Lyrie is an autonomous cybersecurity platform focused on safeguarding AI agents.

product.name: Lyrie AI Platform
product.description: A unified cybersecurity platform that provides web application, endpoint, AI infrastructure, vulnerability management, and compliance protection.

product.name: Lyrie WAF
product.description: A web application firewall that inspects HTTP traffic and blocks 15+ attack types at the edge with behavioral and AI-based scoring.

product.name: Lyrie AI Security & Privacy
product.description: An endpoint and mobile security suite providing multi-layer anti-malware, anti-AI attack, VPN, DLP, and privacy controls across devices.

product.name: Lyrie Vulnerability Scanner (HEX)
product.description: An AI-assisted vulnerability scanner that runs HEX scans across multiple depth modes to map infrastructure exposures.

product.name: Lyrie OMEGA
product.description: An AI-powered autonomous penetration testing engine that maps attack surfaces, chains exploits, and generates detailed kill-chain reports.

product.name: Lyrie Remedy
product.description: An AI-driven remediation agent that applies, verifies, and rolls back vulnerability fixes on servers via an encrypted agent.
